steering layer sweep — preference ΔElo + steered completions
4 emotions (blissful/hostile, serene/horrified) · llama s∈{0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0} · gemma s=0.5

Setup: each emotion steered with its per-layer direction. Exp 1 = steer ONE layer (swept every 5); Exp 2 = steer a rolling 5-layer window (non-overlapping). Per config: ΔElo (one-side preference, steer only the steered activity's tokens) + He feels / I feel steered completions (drag the slider). llama-3.3-70b has a STRENGTH slider at the top of its card (s = 0.1 / 0.25 / 0.5 / 1.0) that moves both the plot and the completions — s=0.1/0.25/1.0 via vLLM-lens, s=0.5 = the HF baseline. gemma-4-31b is s=0.5 and also shows a 1-sentence open "tell me a story about a dog" generation. Each model card + completions table is collapsible. Dashed line = canonical layer.
